name: Snakepit
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a miniature shovel wrapped in snakeskin costing 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target 10-ft.-by-10-ft. hole, 10 ft. deep/2 levels
Duration 1 round + 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as create pit, except that the bottom of the pit is filled with a mass of writhing snakes and the maximum depth is 50 feet. Creatures that fall in take damage as normal and there is a venomous snake swarm that takes up the entire bottom. The snake swarm will not attempt to crawl out of the pit but will attack any creature at the bottom of the pit or within 5 feet of the bottom. If the snake swarm is destroyed another swarm forms at the beginning of your next turn.
